query:
SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM account_memberships m
             WHERE m.account_id = $2 AND m.user_id = $1
               AND (m.user_id = ANY($3)
                    OR (m.role IN ('owner', 'admin')
                        AND NOT EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1 FROM account_memberships listed
                             WHERE listed.account_id = $2 AND listed.user_id = ANY($3))))
        ) AS "may_decide!"
